rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone or something makes you angry or annoyed.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si1 gei1 zan1 hai6 gik1 nau1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for a substance or sensation that irritates body tissue rather than for making someone angry.

example.english: This perfume can irritate my nose.
example.jyutping: nei1 fun2 hoeng1 seoi2 ci3 gik1 ngo5 go3 bei6
